Before you start building, there are a few things I realize we haven't actually walked through yet, and they matter to me for really *managing* my bookmarks — not just adding and finding them one at a time.

- The mess I started with is the pile already sitting in my browser. I'd want to bring those in when I first set this up, rather than re-saving hundreds of links by hand — and to be able to take mine back out again if I ever wanted to.
- When I've got a big collection, I'd want to change the order — newest first, or by title — so I can line them up the way that suits what I'm doing.
- I'd like to tidy in bulk. When I've filtered down to a group, being able to select a bunch of them and, say, add a label to all of them, or archive them together, instead of doing each one.
- A search I keep coming back to — like my pasta-and-weekend one — I'd love to save so I can pull it up again with one click instead of retyping it.
- And a couple of small personal preferences, like how many show at once or the default order and text size.

None of these change what you've already shown me — those all felt right. I just don't want to lock the scope and then find these missing. Could you fold them into what you're about to build? Once I know they're in the plan, I'm happy for you to go ahead and implement.
